versions.changelog:
Initial release — complete appliance repair marketing system.

- 4 included prompts: emergency ads, SEO service pages, review request engine, B2B outreach scripts.
- Covers all major appliance types and key compliance: EPA 608, FTC parts/warranty/language, state contractor licensing.
- Built-in support for brand-specific SEO and legal disclosure requirements.
- Clear inputs required: business details, brands, territory, certification, pricing, and warranty terms.
- Revenue model outlined for lead magnets, full kit, and DFY services.
